description: Frontend: extend LessonSummary interface with deadline fields, add assignment and exam deadline inputs to the teacher lesson form (manage-lessons-notes), and show deadline badges on the kid lesson card. FEAT-002 is independent of FEAT-001 at the TypeScript level (interface fields are optional), but should be implemented after FEAT-001 so the backend can return the new fields.
steps: Step 1 — lesson.ts: in the `LessonSummary` interface, add after `locked?: boolean;`: `assignmentDeadline?: string; assignmentTitle?: string; examDate?: string; examName?: string; hasAssignment?: boolean; hasExam?: boolean;`. All fields are optional so existing code that creates LessonSummary objects is unaffected.

Step 2 — manage-lessons-notes.ts (component properties): add six properties after the `points` field: `hasAssignment: boolean = false; assignmentTitle: string = ''; assignmentDeadline: string = ''; hasExam: boolean = false; examName: string = ''; examDate: string = '';`. The types use string for datetime-local input binding; conversion to ISO string happens in saveLesson().

Step 3 — manage-lessons-notes.ts (saveLesson): extend the `lessonData` inline object literal with six new keys: `hasAssignment: this.hasAssignment, assignmentTitle: this.hasAssignment ? this.assignmentTitle : null, assignmentDeadline: this.hasAssignment && this.assignmentDeadline ? new Date(this.assignmentDeadline).toISOString() : null, hasExam: this.hasExam, examName: this.hasExam ? this.examName : null, examDate: this.hasExam && this.examDate ? new Date(this.examDate).toISOString() : null`.

Step 4 — manage-lessons-notes.ts (resetForm): add reset lines for all six properties after `this.noteContent = '';`: `this.hasAssignment = false; this.assignmentTitle = ''; this.assignmentDeadline = ''; this.hasExam = false; this.examName = ''; this.examDate = '';`.

Step 5 — manage-lessons-notes.ts (editLesson): after `this.noteContent = lesson.content || '';`, add: `this.hasAssignment = lesson.hasAssignment || false; this.assignmentTitle = lesson.assignmentTitle || ''; this.assignmentDeadline = lesson.assignmentDeadline ? new Date(lesson.assignmentDeadline).toISOString().slice(0, 16) : ''; this.hasExam = lesson.hasExam || false; this.examName = lesson.examName || ''; this.examDate = lesson.examDate ? new Date(lesson.examDate).toISOString().slice(0, 16) : '';`. Also add the same fields to the `originalLesson` object literal inside editLesson, and extend the `isLessonFormChanged` getter to include: `|| this.hasAssignment !== this.originalLesson.hasAssignment || this.assignmentTitle !== this.originalLesson.assignmentTitle || this.assignmentDeadline !== this.originalLesson.assignmentDeadline || this.hasExam !== this.originalLesson.hasExam || this.examName !== this.originalLesson.examName || this.examDate !== this.originalLesson.examDate`.

Step 6 — manage-lessons-notes.ts (loadLessons): in the `lessons.map(lesson => ({ ... }))` object, add: `hasAssignment: lesson.hasAssignment || false, assignmentTitle: lesson.assignmentTitle || '', assignmentDeadline: lesson.assignmentDeadline || null, hasExam: lesson.hasExam || false, examName: lesson.examName || '', examDate: lesson.examDate || null`.

Step 7 — manage-lessons-notes.html: add the assignment and exam toggle blocks inside the `<form>`, after the Points `<div class="pb-[40px]">` block and before the yellow Lesson Notes card. Assignment block: a `<div class="pb-[40px]">` containing a flex row with label 'Has Assignment?' + `[(ngModel)]="hasAssignment" name="hasAssignment"` checkbox, and a conditional `*ngIf="hasAssignment"` panel styled `bg-green-50 border border-green-600 rounded-xl p-4` containing: (a) text input bound to `[(ngModel)]="assignmentTitle" name="assignmentTitle"` placeholder 'e.g. Chapter 3 Exercise', (b) `type="datetime-local"` input bound to `[(ngModel)]="assignmentDeadline" name="assignmentDeadline"`. Exam block: same structure for `hasExam`/`examName`/`examDate`. Both blocks use Tailwind classes: label `text-green-700`, input borders `border-green-600`, bg `bg-green-50`, focus ring `focus:ring-green-500`. Match the font/size/padding of existing form fields (`font-fredoka font-semibold text-[20px]`, `h-[60px]`, `rounded-[20px]`, `px-[20px]`).

Step 8 — lesson-card.ts: add two helper methods to the `LessonCard` class: `isFuture(dateStr: string): boolean { return new Date(dateStr) > new Date(); }` and `formatDeadline(dateStr: string): string { return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('en-KE', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); }`.

Step 9 — lesson-card.html: add a badge block inside the INFO SECTION div, after the hidden-md description comment block and before the `` div: `
📝 Due: {{ formatDeadline(lesson.assignmentDeadline) }}📋 Exam: {{ formatDeadline(lesson.examDate) }}
`.
acceptance_criteria: `ng build` from c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\frontend\learnplay exits 0 with no TypeScript errors.
Teacher form renders 'Has Assignment?' checkbox; when checked, shows assignment title input and datetime-local deadline picker styled green.
Teacher form renders 'Has Exam?' checkbox; when checked, shows exam name and datetime-local exam date picker.
saveLesson() sends hasAssignment, assignmentTitle, assignmentDeadline (ISO string), hasExam, examName, examDate to the backend.
editLesson() repopulates all six deadline fields correctly from an existing lesson.
resetForm() clears all six fields back to defaults.
lesson-card.html shows an orange '📝 Due: ...' badge when hasAssignment=true and assignmentDeadline is in the future.
lesson-card.html shows a red '📋 Exam: ...' badge when hasExam=true and examDate is in the future.
No badge is shown when deadline/examDate is in the past or absent.
